# opstracer_escalation_policy (Data Source)

Look up an escalation policy by its exact name, or the org's default policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_escalation_policy" "backend" {
  name = "backend"
}

# The org's default policy, whatever it is called.
data "opstracer_escalation_policy" "default" {
  default = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Set to `true` to fetch the org's default policy instead of matching by name.
- `name` (String) Policy name, matched exactly. Set this or `default`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) Escalation policy ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the org's default policy.
